title: WF03 OBS-03 residual integration blockers after compile-fix rework
summary: OBS-03 runtime blockers were resolved by fixing cursor-param memory ownership in audit pagination, updating identity seed fixture fields for current schema, and correcting session actor assignment during token-revoke auditing.

root_cause.details: TC-OBS-03-INT-05 used a decoded cursor audit_id slice after freeing the decoded cursor buffer, corrupting SQL parameter $6 and causing PostgreSQL ServerError/internal_error on second-page fetch. TC-OBS-03-INT-06 fixture setup used users insert columns that were stale after IDN-01 (missing username/status) and used unsupported parameterized SET LOCAL; both caused QueryFailed in integration setup path.

changes: In src/obs/audit.zig, changed cursor SQL predicate to typed timestamp/UUID comparison and copied cursor audit_id into arena-owned memory before appending query params (fixes use-after-free).
In tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig, updated seedUserAndToken users insert/upsert to include required username/status fields introduced by IDN-01.
In tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig, replaced parameterized SET LOCAL statement with SELECT set_config('bpm.actor_id', $1, true) for transaction-scoped actor context.
In tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig, fixed TC-OBS-03-INT-01 cleanup leak by freeing the Definition returned from store.update.

commands.detail: Command exited 0 (INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=0); OBS-03 integration tests no longer report TC-OBS-03-INT-05/INT-06 failures

prevention: Never append SQL params from slices owned by a soon-to-be-freed buffer; copy decoded cursor fields into query-lifetime allocator memory before query execution.
Keep integration seed helpers aligned with additive identity schema changes (username/status) and avoid unsupported parameterized SQL forms such as SET LOCAL $1.
